age.evidence: Mouse primary myoblasts were isolated from 6-week-old C57BL/6N mice.
For muscle regeneration assays, 50 μL of CTX (20 μmol/L, Sigma-Aldrich, USA) was injected into the tibialis anterior (TA) muscles of 2-month-old mice.

cell_line.evidence: The C2C12 myoblast cell line (Type Culture Collection of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, China) was cultured in Dulbecco’s modified Eagle medium (DMEM, Gibco, USA) with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS, Gibco, USA) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (Gibco, USA).
